info.name: golang
info.category: Compiled to native — small runtime + goroutine scheduler
info.typing: Statically and strongly typed; generics since Go 1.18
info.runtime: Tiny runtime baked into the binary (scheduler + GC + reflect)
info.design_notes: Go compiles ahead-of-time with no JIT warmup and ships a small runtime that supplies a cooperative goroutine scheduler and a low-pause GC. Performance is in the same order of magnitude as Java/C# but cold start is essentially instant. Memory usage is modest.
key_traits: Sub-millisecond GC pauses suit latency-sensitive code
Less aggressive optimization than JVM JITs on tight numerical loops
info.peak_speed: Within 1.5–3× of C++ on most workloads
